question: By what addition are all these mantra forms said to be constituted?
premises: A joining of a pair of seeds beginning with veda is mentioned.
All the forms are declared on that basis.
inference: All these forms are constituted through the addition of that seed-pair.
uncertainties: The specific identity of the veda-initial seed-pair is not explicit here.
plain_english: All are declared through the joining of a pair of seeds beginning with veda.
